name: SteadyScript
tagline: Fine-motor therapy with a smart pen and camera that measure tremor and stability as you practise writing.
problem: People with Parkinson's, stroke or brain injury need guided fine-motor practice, and access to therapy is uneven.
solution: An Arduino-based device and computer vision stream stability data in real time to a web app with hand-gesture controls and session statistics.
demo_moment: Team-described: trace a pattern and watch the live stability graph.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Beginner Project” and “[PCCA] Best Wellness Related Hack” among 169 submissions.
A beginner team built hardware plus a real-time dashboard.
Frames a broad group of users beyond Parkinson's.

lessons: Beginner teams can win with hardware if the loop is simple and live.
